semiconductor_relevance: High — WIN Semiconductors Corp. is a leading pure-play foundry specializing in GaAs technology, providing essential fabrication services for RF and optoelectronic devices.
summary: WIN Semiconductors Corp. is the world's first pure-play 6-inch GaAs foundry, established to meet the increasing demand for high-speed and high-quality GaAs MMICs and RFICs. The company offers dedicated foundry services to design houses and integrated device manufacturers, leveraging advanced GaAs technology for various applications.
capabilities: Optoelectronic device fabrication for optical communication
